title: Desk organizer prototypes (5) from leftover wood
purpose: Fictional small furniture manufacturer testing five desk-organizer prototypes built from existing leftover hardwood. Only the joining and finishing materials are purchased.

suppliedInventory.name: Leftover walnut and maple offcuts, 3/4 in thick
suppliedInventory.quantity: enough for 5 organizers (about 10 x 5 in bases plus dividers)
suppliedInventory.note: Existing shop inventory. Supplied, not purchased.

lines.title: Wood glue
lines.description: One bottle of new wood glue, at least 8 fl oz, to join the walnut and maple pieces of five organizers. Water resistant preferred.

lines.title: Cork backing sheets
lines.description: Self-adhesive backing required. Cork sheets at least 12 x 12 inch, 1/8 inch thick, one sheet per organizer base (bases are about 10 x 5 in).

lines.title: Wood screws
lines.description: #6 x 5/8 inch flat head wood screws, 8 per organizer for five organizers (40 total). Flat head required for countersinking into 3/4 in stock.
